title: Proof of knot factor spectral derivation
html: Proof. By (Gram--spectral connection), the Gram matrix is block-diagonal in the central-idempotent basis \{e_\lambda\} with entries G_{\lambda \mu} = \delta_{\lambda \mu} \cdot \dim_q V_\lambda \cdot \dim V_\lambda / [n]_q!. Expanding \beta_\mathcal{K}, \beta_\mathcal{K}^* in \{e_\lambda\} and substituting yields the displayed sum, which is the depth-stratified specialisation of the unified mass functional (unified mass formula) restricted to the chirality projection. \square
